canonical_question: How does the 'fractal dimension less than 2' at the end of simulations compare to the '2.4 at the transition'?

question_variants.question: How does the 'fractal dimension less than 2' at the end of simulations compare to the '2.4 at the transition'?
question_variants.resolution_summary: The simulation results show a fractal dimension of around 2.4 at the transition point, which decreases to less than 2 by the end of the simulations.

answers.answer: The fractal dimension is around 2.4 at the transition and less than 2 at the end of the simulations.
answers.conditions: At transition vs end of simulation
evidence_spans: We study the effects of the chemical short-range order (SRO) on the thermal conductivity of the refractory high-entropy alloy HfNbTaTiZr using atomistic simulation.
Samples with different degrees of chemical SRO are prepared by a Monte Carlo scheme.
With increasing SRO, a tendency of forming HfTi and TiZr clusters is found.
